adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /v2/whoami (official first-call probe and pinned credential validator).
This recipe is the long-lived access-token edition. Official docs: access tokens do not use x-company-guid; that header is OAuth-partner-only and is omitted.
x-api-version is optional; tokens carry a default version when the header is omitted. Native does not force a version pin.
Native category is scheduling. Source Productivity is not the best allowlist match for restaurant workforce scheduling.
Returns raw provider JSON under data instead of the pinned camelCase identity wrapper. Upstream user-agent is not sent.

Maps to official GET /v2/companies/{id}. id is a required integer. Returns raw JSON under data; official retrieve-company sample is the company object, not a data wrapper.

Maps to official GET /v2/company/{company_id}/locations (singular company). Optional modified_since, deleted, cursor, and limit bind to documented query names. Native limit maximum is 500 per official docs.
